results.description:
Would you like to improve your spoken Spanish and gain the confidence to take part in everyday conversations with other Spanish speakers? The Michel Thomas approach makes language learning feel natural. Learn without stress, pressure or homework and see genuine results that you can use straight away.

Designed for anyone with a basic understanding of Spanish, or anyone who has already completed Michel Thomas Foundation Spanish and Spanish Foundation Plus, this six-hour audio lesson will improve your conversational Spanish as well as your command of grammar and vocabulary.

Listen to renowned language teacher Michel Thomas as he teaches two language learners and take part as the third learner. The courses are unscripted: you will hear the students' progression in the studio from a basic grasp of Spanish to confident speakers, and you will learn from their successes, as well as their mistakes.
Michel Thomas is the original audio course for language learning, with 50 years of real results and over five million satisfied language learners.

"A unique and perfectly brilliant way of teaching languages." (Stephen Fry in Rescuing the Spectacled Bear)

Once you have completed Intermediate Spanish, there are more Michel Thomas courses to deepen your understanding. We recommend progressing to Spanish Vocabulary and Fluent Spanish Conversation to progress even further and bring more ease and confidence to your spoken Spanish.

This course is taught by Michel Thomas himself. Michel Thomas (1914-2005) was a gifted linguist who mastered 10 languages in his lifetime. He spent 50 years continuously refining his courses and perfecting his method. Millions of learners worldwide have mastered language thanks to his unique approach.

PLEASE NOTE: When you purchase this course, you will also receive a free supporting booklet with user guide and glossary, which you will find in your Library along with the audio.
